source_posture: exact final implementation source after native main-thread stack repair, boxed watcher-event snapshot repair, and exact adapter-cost assertions; only evidence-number and documentation closure edits followed measurement

commands.warm_link: cargo clean -p worth-ui-platform-pulse --target-dir <isolated-target> && cargo build -p worth-ui-platform-pulse --target-dir <isolated-target>

launch.measurement_method: Windows process CreationDate to redirected publication-log LastWriteTime; the result is an upper bound because the marker may precede the filesystem timestamp.

retained_artifacts.budget_basis: Only files named for worth-ui-platform-pulse and its fingerprint directory are charged as the additional retained package artifacts. The full isolated target is reported separately and is not misrepresented as incremental package cost.

notes: A real native launch exposed a pre-publication Windows stack overflow that library tests had missed.
The root cause was multiplication of a 160-byte move-only source fact across 64 inline transport slots and several by-value scheduler states.

Owned source truth reduced admitted ingress from 216 to 64 bytes and the prepared replacement commit from 52264 to 23080 bytes while preserving fixed-capacity allocation-free mailbox insertion and drain.
A 24 KiB prepared-commit footprint cap and a 512 KiB replacement prepare/receipt/commit regression keep the repair causal.
The watcher event carries its settled snapshot by Box so its denial alternative does not create a large enum variant; the final-source measurements include that Clippy-driven repair.
